comments: Poor SP and OW habitat. Mod. Rearing habitat.

There is a beaver dam located at the north end of lake. There is approx. 150m of shallow, open water directly south of the beaver dam, then 150m of sedges with no obvious channel south to the main part of lake. There is limited spawning habitat in the outlet creek and limited access for spawners from the lake to the creek. There is no trail or road access to this lake.
RB were caught directly downstream of 1.2m high bedrock falls located 5m upstream (@11/287891/5552800 GIS) of road crossing , no fish were caught upstream of 1.2m high falls.
